nodes.title: ADR 0045: Isolate production PHP-FPM by Unix user
ADR 0038: Cascade AppInstance removal through processes and schedules
ADR 0044: Own AppInstance environment configuration in Orbit
ADR 0031: Clone initial production source during provisioning
ADR 0047: Create production AppInstances from candidates
ADR 0046: Own production release deployment in Orbit

description:
An operator explicitly converts an existing production AppInstance to dedicated PHP services and release placement without losing its source, environment, database, or local tuning.

## Scope

* In: a recoverable existing-placement conversion and its Gateway, SDK, and CLI surfaces.
* Out: database schema conversion, a new candidate requirement for existing instances, automatic fleet migration, application commands, and legacy Instance or Workspace conversion.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `POST /instances/{instance}/deployment-layout` and `orbit instance:prepare-deployment INSTANCE` convert one authorized existing production AppInstance, with optional `sqlite_source_path`; preflight inventories existing source, environment ownership, runtime tuning, path conflicts, and serving associations before mutation. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/AppInstanceDeploymentLayoutTest.php` and Incus action `production-adoption-preflight`.
- [ ] The existing checkout becomes a retained release selected by `current` without fetching newer code; file content, ignored files, executable modes, and Git state are preserved, and existing `.env` and explicitly selected SQLite content remain durable outside releases. Proof: Incus action `production-adoption-content`.
- [ ] An unmanaged existing environment file must first be explicitly imported through Orbit; missing ownership or disagreement with stored values refuses conversion before mutation rather than silently replacing local values. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/AdoptProductionLayoutTest.php`.
- [ ] PHP conversion preserves local tuning in the new runtime’s local configuration, verifies its effective identity, then moves only this workload to its dedicated socket; another user’s shared or dedicated service is never restarted or reset as a side effect. Proof: Incus action `production-adoption-runtime`.
- [ ] Interruption at file movement, persistent-state placement, runtime publication, or Route projection leaves recorded resumable conversion progress; retry preserves exact retained content and never reports completion until the recorded layout and serving path agree. Proof: Incus action `production-adoption-retry`.
- [ ] Unsupported tuning or a conflicting destination refuses conversion with the old workload unchanged; repeated completed conversion preserves the selected release and all subsequent local edits, and converted content remains covered by normal removal retention. Proof: Incus action `production-adoption-conflict`.
- [ ] The SDK sends typed conversion inputs and the CLI uses HTTP only, presents bounded failures, and supports deterministic human and JSON responses. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/AppInstances/AppInstanceDeploymentLayoutRequestTest.php` and `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/PrepareDeploymentCommandTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes explicit conversion, environment import prerequisites, retained content, and recovery, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, `cd packages/php-sdk && composer check`, `cd apps/cli && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
- [ ] Relocating an existing SQLite database requires the operating agent to quiesce the existing application first; active owned application processes or an open database prevent relocation, and Orbit infers no application shutdown, queue, or migration commands. Proof: Incus action `production-adoption-sqlite-precondition`.
title: Prepare existing production instances for Orbit deployments
